description: Information related to a specific transportation indication to be reported on a WHO MDH (Maritime Declaration of Health).

appliedSanitaryMeasure.description: A sanitary measure applied for this MDH health indication.

description.description: A textual description of this MDH health indication.

locationId.description: An identifier of a location for this MDH health indication.

locationName.description: A location name, expressed as text, of a location for this MDH health indication.

reportedDateTime.description: A reported date, time, date time or other date time value for this MDH health indication.

reportedQuantity.description: A reported quantity for this MDH health indication.

statusIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not the status of this MDH health indication is true or false.

typeCode.description: A code specifying a type of MDH health indication.
